description: This script analyzes markdown documentation files to identify glossary terms, compare them with a localized glossary, and report missing entries. It integrates with Git to determine file changes and processes files to extract glossary-related terms, focusing on documentation files in the 'docs' directory, excluding Chinese localization.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to extract '--base' and '--head' options.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a git command with specified arguments and returns the trimmed output.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Determines the base commit or branch for diff comparison, considering explicit arguments, environment variables, or default candidates.

methods.name: listChangedDocs
methods.description: Lists markdown documentation files in the 'docs' directory that have changed between the base and head commits.

methods.name: loadGlossarySources
methods.description: Loads and parses the localized glossary JSON file, returning a set of known glossary terms.

methods.name: containsLatin
methods.description: Checks if a given string contains Latin alphabet characters.

methods.name: wordCount
methods.description: Counts the number of words in a given string.

methods.name: unquoteScalar
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a string, if present.

methods.name: isGlossaryCandidate
methods.description: Determines if a term qualifies as a glossary candidate based on length, character content, and word count.

methods.name: readGitFile
methods.description: Retrieves file contents from a specific git commit or branch.

methods.name: extractTerms
methods.description: Parses document text to extract glossary-related terms from titles and list item links, returning a map of term matches.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function coordinating argument parsing, git operations, loading glossary, and reporting missing glossary entries for changed docs.
